slide1.title: High Prevalence in Head & Neck Cancers
slide1.desc: Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma (NPC) is one of the leading malignant cancers of the Head, Neck, and Nasal region in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.

slide2.title: Subtle Early Symptoms
slide2.desc: Due to its deep anatomical location within the nasopharynx, early signs are often mistaken for common rhinitis or pharyngitis, making clinical detection difficult.

slide3.title: Diagnosed at Advanced Stages
slide3.desc: Over 70% of patients are diagnosed at Stage III or IV, significantly reducing treatment efficacy and overall prognosis.

slide4.title: Early Stage Survival Rate
slide4.desc: When diagnosed and treated early at Stage I, the 5-year survival rate reaches between 80% and 90%.
